newsitem.title: UK: Phonelink down as company stays in red.
newsitem.headline: Phonelink down as company stays in red.

text.p: Shares in electronic information group Phonelink Plc were marked 22 percent lower on Thursday as the company announced continued losses and the stock backtracked from recent gains.
Shares in the company -- whose products include the online database and communications package Tel-Me -- were down 15p at 51-1/2 by 1411 GMT.
Phonelink shares have rallied from a record low of 30p set on May 22 but remain well below their high of 441p set in March 1994.

The company reported a pre-tax loss of 6.2 million stg for the year ended March 31, down from last year's 6.7 million loss, and said a strategy of cutting costs had succeeded in reducing cash consumption.
Yet traders said there was little new in the statement to prompt any fresh interest in the stock.
